rights.basis: Charles B. MacDonald, Company Commander: the syllabus says it is under closely held copyright. A book to buy; named only, no link.

syllabus_notes: For our class session, we’ll take a look at how the U.S. engaged in combat operations in Europe and the Pacific, the similarities and differences. You should also think about the ways in which MacDonald’s account of his experience as a company commander illustrates U.S. Army operational methods in Europe. We’ll be talking about MacDonald and the papers on his book in class.
